policy: Individually measured stellar companions of pulsars in the compact-remnant overlay. Each value comes from the cited paper; nothing is copied from the pulsar except its system position and astrometry, which the companion shares. Upper limits are kept in notes, not stored as measurements.

companions.note: Helium white dwarf seen in optical and infrared spectra; its hydrogen-atmosphere fit gives log g = 6.98 ± 0.15.
Low-mass helium-core white dwarf with Balmer absorption lines (DA; van Kerkwijk et al. 1996).
Mass from the Shapiro delay; ATNF classifies the companion as a carbon–oxygen white dwarf.
Optical non-detection limits its effective temperature to below 3000 K (Kaplan et al. 2014, https://arxiv.org/abs/1406.0488), making it one of the coolest white dwarfs known.
